newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Oct palm oil exports 736,374t -SGS.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Oct palm oil exports 736,374t -SGS.

text.p: Cargo surveyor, Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) Malaysia Sdn Bhd said on Thursday it estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for October at 736,374 tonnes compared with 672,153 tonnes for September.
It said the exports comprised 175,693 tonnes of RBD palm oil, 321,955 tonnes of RBD palm olein and 88,193 tonnes of RBD palm stearin. The other products accounted for 150,533 tonnes.
SGS said China was the top buyer in October, taking 111,500 tonnes followed by Pakistan which bought 105,850 tonnes, India (104,820 tonnes) and Japan (37,249 tonnes).
Countries in the European Union bought 116,730 tonnes while Middle East countries took 45,550 tonnes, it said.
